findings.desc: CHK-001:edge:1 lacks a concrete bound check: the intent requires writeProposal to be tested with a path-traversal id (e.g. ../etc/passwd) to confirm it is sanitized or rejected without writing outside proposals/. The safeProposalId guard exists in learning-store.ts but the smoke contains no check that invokes writeProposal (or the handler) with such an id and asserts the expected rejection. The evidence note is a generic-fallback description that covers all 9 CHK-001 intents identically; it does not state that this specific adversarial boundary was exercised.

CHK-001:adversarial:1 has no verificationEvidence binding to any concurrent-write test: the intent requires writeProposal called concurrently with the same id to produce last-write-wins or an atomic error, never corrupted JSON. The smoke contains zero concurrency checks and the evidence record reuses the identical generic note and command as the happy-path entries (all 9 CHK-001 evidence records share the same note: 'playbook+proposal types; learning-store round-trips playbooks.json+proposals/...'). There is no waiver explaining why this must-intent is exempted from automation. This is an uncovered must-intent.
